pages.text: The Blacksmith's Assistant is a way of automating the Blacksmith's Anvil. You need to place a tank full of some form of liquid xp underneath it. In Mariculture you can obtain some molten experience by melting down enchanted items in a crucible furnace (as long as that crucible furnace has an ethereal upgrade).
pages.title: Blacksmith's Assistant

pages.text: You then must supply the appropriate side with a hammer, and it will get to work.
